findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with an Italian sentence ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'), so Lithuanian users will see Italian. The same mistake is in login/messages_lt.properties loginTotpStep1 (line 71).

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body: totpStep1 was set to Traditional Chinese ('在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：') in the zh_CN (Simplified) file, so the string does not match the rest of the locale.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat choice syntax used in i18next bundle
findings.body: The account UI uses i18next interpolation ({{0}}), but error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed to Java MessageFormat syntax ({0}, {2,choice,...}). It will render literally as '{0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' in the React UI. The admin-ui messages_en.properties has the same problem.

findings.title: English file path derivation breaks on paths and throws for missing file
findings.body: The English path is built with a global replaceAll of 'resources-community'→'resources'. Any file without a locale suffix, or with no English counterpart, makes the code throw a RuntimeException. That fails the whole build instead of reporting a message. The regex `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` can also match the first underscore in the file name, not just the locale suffix.

findings.title: Anchor removal uses replaceFirst on the whole string, not the matched position
findings.body: After an anchor matches the English one, the code removes the first occurrence of that text anywhere in the value. It does this while the matcher is still iterating over the original string, so later positions are evaluated against stale offsets. Anchors are also stripped before sanitizing, so any attributes they carry (for example javascript: hrefs that equal the English source) are never checked by the sanitizer.
